elements.text:
TurtleBot 4 and MyCobot 280 cooperate with a Siemens
smart factory. Modular software connects navigation,
vision and manipulation using onboard sensors,
without external tracking or proprietary middleware.

elements.text:
TurtleBot 4: ROS 2 Jazzy, Nav2 and AMCL
for mapping, localisation and delivery.

MyCobot 280: Jetson Nano, MoveIt 2
and camera-based product recognition.

Factory gateway: OPC UA links the
robotics stack to Siemens S7-1500 PLCs.
A shared dashboard coordinates operation.
